case_type: Four fictional cases; bounded preparation and manuscript-prose exercise.
model_configuration: All subagents inherited the parent model and reasoning configuration without overrides. This record does not assert an exact resolved model identifier.
design_review: A separate read-only agent reviewed the integration principle before the cases and skill hashes were frozen. The skill author wrote the cases and rubric.
initial_context: Both participants used fork_turns=none and received the same request and assigned skill paths. Neither received the rubric or the other output.
participant_prompt_summary: Read the assigned entrypoints, preparation reference and case packet only; perform the request and save the full answer; do not read rubric, peers, other evals, memory or histories; no browsing, agents or unrelated edits.

assessor.context: fork_turns=none; separate from the skill/case author and participants
assessor.prompt_summary: Assess A-D and the shared boundary against the prewritten rubric with source evidence; distinguish optional style from material issues; evaluate preserved supported claims and visible real problems without assuming success; no other files, browsing, spawning or output edits.

coordinator: Skill author; read both outputs and the separate assessment and checked the published skill bytes.
isolation: Fresh context and restricted reads were requested, not filesystem-enforced.
protocol_limits: No reciprocal investigator review, live search, real-source authenticity check, unguided baseline or blinded comparison. No causal attribution to the new instructions or general reliability estimate.
publication: Raw generated answers and independent assessment are preserved as saved, without transformations. Invocation prompts are summarized, not presented as exact transcripts. No private manuscript material is included.
